column1: # The software register: one verdict per name this repo installs, against the three rules of
# checks it (bin/check.sh §15); docs/security/software-supply/register.md says how to read a row,
# how to add one, and lists the waivers and the Origin rulings.
# Names: the pacman lists, the [dram] install set, Flatpak app IDs, Nix home.packages and
# programs, and Windows' packages/winget/*.txt (winget:<id>, msstore:<id>, manual:<name>).
# Four TAB-separated columns: name, verdict, until (a waiver's re-check date, else -), note.
# A note gives the evidence: the license; who leads the project and where, as published; how
# many of the four Community criteria it meets (in Arch's repos or verified on Flathub; two or
# more maintainers or a steward; a release in the last 12 months; an answered tracker); and any
# ruling, with its date and its decision ID (decisions/log.md).
# Verdicts: pass, pass-flag (Origin unclear, accepted by a ruling), waiver (signed, with a
# re-check date), swap (decided to go: the note says to what), pending (awaiting a ruling),
# Adding a package = its manifest line + its row here, in the same commit.
